title: Toddler in Western Sweater with Mother, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-20th-century outdoor snapshot capturing a small child in a patterned knit cardigan with Western cowboy motifs standing next to an adult, likely their mother, whose upper body is framed out of the shot. The pair is positioned in a suburban garden with dense ivy leaves climbing along the left, a wooden picket fence in the background, and dappled sunlight casting soft shadows across the lawn.
